name: textplot
description: ASCII and Unicode data visualization in pure SQL. Bars, density plots, sparklines, and QR codes — fully styled with named parameters — rendered as VARCHAR columns you can drop into terminal output, dashboards, log lines, and READMEs.

cta.title: Charts in Your SELECT Statement
cta.description: Install Textplot to render bars, sparklines, density plots, and QR codes inline in any DuckDB query — no chart library, no exports, just SQL.
